gaps.lead: Although he is remarkably rich, he lives very simply.
gaps.explanation: Although he may be rich → Rich as (he) may be — fronted adjective + as + may.

gaps.lead: People thought the species had died out completely.
gaps.explanation: 'People thought it had died out' becomes 'it was thought to have died out'.

gaps.lead: Assembling the wardrobe took me two hours.
gaps.explanation: it took me X to do = I spent X doing.

gaps.lead: The bad weather meant we couldn't leave the house.
Fewer students enrolled this year than we expected.
gaps.explanation: fewer than expected = not as many (students) as expected.
last did X in (year) = haven't done X since (year).
